default_dir.description: Base directory for CRM114 runtime files (dictionaries, logs).

mail_dir.description: Directory where incoming mail is staged for classification.

word_separator.description: Regex pattern to split text into tokens (e.g., whitespace, punctuation).

case_sensitive.description: Whether tokenization should preserve case. Disable for better generalization.

default_category.description: Category assigned to unclassified messages. Typically 'SPAM', 'HAM', or 'UNKNOWN'.

require_training.description: If true, classify only if sufficient training data exists; otherwise assign default category.

max_training_items.description: Maximum number of items (messages) to retain per category in memory/dict.

spam_cutoff.description: Minimum probability (0.0–1.0) to classify a message as SPAM.

ham_cutoff.description: Maximum probability (0.0–1.0) to classify a message as HAM (below this = HAM, above = SPAM, in-between = UNKNOWN).

max_features.description: Upper limit on number of tokens used per message for classification.

spam_dict_file.description: Path to persistent dictionary storing SPAM-specific token statistics.

ham_dict_file.description: Path to persistent dictionary storing HAM-specific token statistics.

preprocess_rules.description: List of regex-based preprocessing rules applied to text before tokenization.

pattern.description: Perl-compatible regex pattern to match (no delimiters).

feature_weights.description: List of per-feature weight overrides (e.g., to boost/mute specific tokens).

min_word_length.description: Minimum token length to include (0 = no minimum). Reduces noise from very short tokens.

max_word_length.description: Maximum token length to include (0 = no maximum). Cuts off unreasonably long tokens.

tokenization_mode.description: Advanced tokenization strategy: e.g., 'UTF8' (for multilingual), 'EMAIL' (for MIME-aware parsing). Leave empty for default.

max_threads.description: Maximum concurrent threads for parallel classification (0 = auto-detect or disabled). Requires threaded build.
